judgments.rationale: Source passage F003 explicitly states that applicants may inspect public records during opening hours. Setting action to 'inspect', object to 'public records', and capturing 'during opening hours' in scope fields accurately populates the missing components of claim C0003 without altering its legal force.

The proposed summary improperly aggregates distinct provisions into claim C0000 and factually misattributes the statutory obligation in clause (iii): clause (iii) mandates that 'The agency' publish annual statistics, whereas the proposed summary asserts that 'Applicants must publish annual statistics on requests.'

Claim C0000 governs clause (i), which establishes the discrete permission for applicants to submit requests electronically. Clause (ii) imposes a separate mandatory requirement that is already independently captured in claim C0001; merging it into C0000's summary and context conflates distinct duties.
Source passage F000 directly supports completing the previously blank action ('submit') and object ('a request electronically') fields for the permission granted to applicants under clause (i).
